description: Rental prices per GPU-hour (USD) for eight GPU classes, per named source, eleven sources in all. Vast.ai: the median of verified on-demand offers with min/p75 and offer counts, the collection timestamp and the Rent Index (this week's median against last week and against the first week collected, a trend word, the days excluded as marketplace glitches). Clore.ai: the median for the same class, a second marketplace kept apart from the first. RunPod: its lowest posted on-demand price (a list price, not a median). AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, Lambda, Nebius, CoreWeave, Hyperstack and Google Cloud: pay-as-you-go list prices, each with the instance type, VM size or shape the price sits in (read four times a day, no statement about capacity). The index describes what prices did; it is not a forecast.
name: gpu_prices
title: GPU rental prices
